summary.zh: 编写和校验 SOP 与运行手册
summary.en: Write, check and clean up SOPs and runbooks for operations.

description.zh: 生成并检查 SOP 与运行手册，按 5W2H 核对完整性，检查引用链接是否失效，也能整理已有的知识库内容。适合补写操作流程、把口耳相传的经验沉淀成文档时使用。
description.en: Writes SOPs and runbooks, checks them for 5W2H completeness and broken links, and ingests an existing knowledge base. Useful when undocumented processes need writing down or old docs need cleanup.
